warnings.message: Net LED_IICRST has no driving source (Pin R23-1, Pin U2-39)
warnings.disposition: R23 10 kohm pulls pin 39 to GND. IICRST is active high and must be low during normal operation. Passive bias is not an active output driver.

warnings.message: Net NRST has no driving source (Pin C12-1, Pin R10-2, Pin TP8-1, Pin U1-6)
warnings.disposition: R10 10 kohm pulls NRST to +3V3; C12 provides filtering. A passive pull-up does not satisfy the compiler active-driver check.

source: https://www.lumissil.com/assets/pdf/core/IS31FL3737B_DS.pdf; Rev D, pin table page 4 and I2C RESET page 24
limit: Reset thresholds, startup and programming behavior require the physical qualification record; no hardware result is implied.
